settings.title: About Prüv
settings.qa:
What is Prüv?
Prüv is a science-led personal-care brand focused on high-performance systems for hair, scalp and skin. We formulate around real-world concerns, purposeful ingredients and evidence-conscious claims — without unnecessary complexity.
|||
What makes Prüv different?
We build focused systems rather than isolated products. Every formula is designed around a specific role, with ingredients selected for function, compatibility and performance.
|||
What does RESET · SUPPORT · REPAIR mean?
It is Prüv’s three-step approach to hair and scalp care. RESET addresses the environment around the hair and scalp. SUPPORT focuses on the root and hair-growth environment. REPAIR focuses on damaged lengths and the hair fibre.
|||
Is Prüv an Indian brand?
Yes. Prüv is an Indian personal-care brand with the ambition to build globally relevant products rooted in science, performance and modern design.
|||
Where are Prüv products made?
Prüv products are formulated and manufactured in India through qualified manufacturing partners in accordance with applicable cosmetic manufacturing and quality requirements.
|||
Is Prüv only a haircare brand?
Hair and scalp care are where Prüv begins. The wider vision extends across skin, scalp and appearance-focused personal care.
|||
Do I need to use the complete Prüv system?
No. Each product is designed to work independently. Used together, the products address different parts of the hair-health equation: scalp cleansing and environmental buildup, growth support, and fibre repair.

settings.title: Products
settings.qa:
## TRISHIELD Element Defense Shampoo
|||
What does TRISHIELD do?
TRISHIELD is designed around three common environmental and scalp concerns: hard-water buildup, pollution-related residue and scalp microbiome support. Its cleansing and chelating system helps remove accumulated residue while microbiome-supporting ingredients help maintain a balanced scalp environment.
|||
How does TRISHIELD help with hard water?
Sodium Gluconate and Disodium EDTA help bind mineral ions associated with hard water, helping accumulated mineral residue rinse away during cleansing.
|||
How does TRISHIELD help with pollution?
Its cleansing system and Salicylic Acid help remove accumulated oil, residue and environmental impurities from the scalp and hair.
|||
How does it support the scalp microbiome?
TRISHIELD contains Inulin, Alpha-Glucan Oligosaccharide and Lactococcus Ferment Lysate, selected to support a balanced scalp environment.
|||
What are the key actives in TRISHIELD?
Key ingredients include Sodium Gluconate, Disodium EDTA, Salicylic Acid, Inulin, Alpha-Glucan Oligosaccharide, Lactococcus Ferment Lysate, Niacinamide and Panthenol.
|||
Is TRISHIELD a clarifying shampoo?
It provides a targeted, deeper cleanse, but it is designed as part of a regular haircare routine rather than only as an occasional heavy cleanser.
|||
Is it suitable for oily scalps?
Yes. Its cleansing system and Salicylic Acid can be particularly useful for scalps prone to excess oil and buildup.
|||
Is it suitable for dry or processed hair?
It can be used on dry or processed hair, but wash frequency should be adapted to the individual. Follow with the Breakage Repair Mask if the lengths are dry, porous or damage-prone.
|||
Does TRISHIELD contain sulphates?
TRISHIELD does not contain traditional sulphate surfactants such as Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (SLS) or Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES). It uses Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate as part of its cleansing system.
|||
Is Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate a sulphate?
No. Chemically, it is a sulfonate rather than a sulphate. It is still an effective cleanser and may feel stronger than very mild surfactant systems.
|||
Does TRISHIELD contain fragrance?
Yes. The current formulation contains fragrance.
|||
## VECTOR-5 Advanced Multi-Pathway Structural Density Serum
|||
What does VECTOR-5 do?
VECTOR-5 is a leave-on scalp serum designed to support the appearance of fuller, denser and more resilient hair over time. It combines multiple hair-support pathways rather than relying on a single active.
|||
How does VECTOR-5 work?
The formula combines HairVivine Pro®, Procapil®, Baicapil®, AnaGain®, Aminexil, Copper Tripeptide, Caffeine, Niacinamide, Zinc PCA and Saw Palmetto Extract to support the scalp environment, hair-growth cycle, anchoring and the appearance of density.
|||
What are the key actives in VECTOR-5?
Key actives include HairVivine Pro®, Procapil®, Baicapil®, AnaGain®, Aminexil, Copper Tripeptide, Caffeine, Niacinamide and Zinc PCA.
|||
Is VECTOR-5 a medicine?
No. VECTOR-5 is a cosmetic scalp treatment and is not intended to replace medical treatment for hair loss.
|||
Does VECTOR-5 contain minoxidil or finasteride?
No. VECTOR-5 does not contain minoxidil or finasteride.
|||
Do I rinse VECTOR-5 out?
No. It is designed as a leave-on scalp treatment.
|||
Can men and women use VECTOR-5?
Yes. VECTOR-5 is designed as a unisex scalp treatment.
|||
Can I use VECTOR-5 on my hair lengths?
VECTOR-5 is designed primarily for direct scalp application rather than use as a conditioning serum on the lengths.
|||
## Breakage Repair Keratin-Ceramide Mask
|||
What does the Breakage Repair Mask do?
It is designed to reinforce damaged, dry and breakage-prone hair while improving softness, flexibility, smoothness and manageability.
|||
How does the mask work?
Ceramides support the hair fibre’s lipid structure, while Hydrolyzed Keratin and Silk Protein provide conditioning and structural support. Panthenol, Argan Oil, Shea Butter and targeted conditioning agents improve softness, slip and resilience.
|||
What are the key actives in the mask?
Key ingredients include Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Cholesterol, Phytosphingosine, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Hydrolyzed Silk, Panthenol, Argan Oil and Shea Butter.
|||
Does the mask repair split ends permanently?
No cosmetic mask can permanently fuse severely split ends. It can smooth and condition damaged ends and reduce their rough appearance, but severely split ends ultimately require trimming.
|||
Does the mask contain protein?
Yes. It contains Hydrolyzed Keratin and Hydrolyzed Silk Protein.
|||
Does the mask contain silicones?
Yes. It contains Amodimethicone, used for targeted conditioning, improved smoothness and easier combing of damaged hair.
|||
Is silicone bad for hair?
Not inherently. Silicones are widely used in haircare to reduce friction, improve combability and protect compromised fibres from mechanical stress.
|||
Where should I apply the mask?
Focus primarily on the mid-lengths and ends rather than the scalp.

settings.title: Ingredients & Formulation
settings.qa:
What does “science-led” mean at Prüv?
It means ingredients are selected for a defined function within the formula, informed by cosmetic science, supplier research, published evidence where applicable, formulation compatibility and appropriate product testing.
|||
Does a longer ingredient list mean a better product?
No. Ingredient concentration, compatibility, stability, delivery and the architecture of the complete formula matter more than ingredient count.
|||
Are all of Prüv’s ingredients natural?
Prüv does not formulate around an arbitrary natural-versus-synthetic philosophy. Ingredients are selected based on function, safety, performance, stability and formulation compatibility.
|||
Are synthetic ingredients unsafe?
No. Whether an ingredient is natural, naturally derived or synthetic does not by itself determine safety or performance.
|||
Why do Prüv products use preservatives?
Water-based personal-care products require appropriate preservation to protect against microbial contamination during manufacture, storage and consumer use.
|||
Why do some Prüv products contain fragrance?
Fragrance contributes to the sensory experience of the product. If you are particularly sensitive to fragrance, review the complete ingredient list before use.
|||
Are Prüv products paraben-free?
The current launch formulations do not list parabens. Always refer to the current ingredient list on the individual product page and packaging.
|||
Are Prüv products silicone-free?
Not all products are silicone-free. The Breakage Repair Mask contains Amodimethicone because it contributes to conditioning, reduced friction and damage management.
|||
Where can I find the full ingredient list?
The full INCI declaration is provided on the individual product page and on the product packaging.
|||
Are Prüv products dermatologist tested?
Only individual products that have completed appropriate testing should carry this claim. Refer to the specific product page or packaging for the current validated claim.
|||
Are Prüv products clinically tested?
Ingredient-level clinical evidence and finished-product clinical testing are not the same. Prüv uses finished-product clinical claims only where the relevant studies supports them.

settings.title: Routine & Results
settings.qa:
What is the ideal Prüv routine?
On wash days: 1) cleanse with TRISHIELD, 2) apply the Breakage Repair Mask to mid-lengths and ends and rinse, 3) apply VECTOR-5 directly to the scalp as directed. VECTOR-5 can also be used on non-wash days according to the directions on pack.
|||
Can I use all three products together?
Yes. They are designed to address complementary concerns within one system.
|||
How often should I use TRISHIELD?
Use it according to your scalp, hair type and normal wash frequency. If your scalp is sensitive or you wash very frequently, adjust use based on tolerance.
|||
How often should I use the Breakage Repair Mask?
Typically one to two times per week, or according to the condition of your hair and the directions on pack.
|||
How often should I use VECTOR-5?
Use consistently according to the directions on pack. For density-support routines, consistent application matters more than occasional heavy application.
|||
Can I use the serum on non-wash days?
Yes, provided your scalp is comfortable and the use is consistent with the directions on pack.
|||
Can I use hair oil with VECTOR-5?
Yes, but avoid applying heavy oil immediately before the serum. If you oil your scalp, cleanse thoroughly before applying VECTOR-5 so the treatment can contact the scalp evenly.
|||
Can I use styling products after VECTOR-5?
Yes. Allow the serum to absorb before layering styling products.
|||
Can I use other brands alongside Prüv?
Yes. Prüv does not require an exclusive routine.
|||
How quickly will I see results?
The shampoo and mask may provide sensory benefits such as cleanliness, smoothness and manageability from early use. Density-related changes from a scalp serum require consistent use across the natural hair-growth cycle and take longer.
|||
Are results guaranteed?
No cosmetic product can guarantee identical results for every individual.
|||
Why do results vary?
Hair condition and hair fall can be influenced by genetics, hormones, nutrition, stress, environment, styling, chemical treatments, medical conditions and consistency of use.
|||
Will using more serum give faster results?
No. Use the recommended amount. Applying more product does not necessarily accelerate results and may increase residue or irritation.
|||
Will results continue if I stop using the serum?
Hair and scalp conditions continue to change over time. Benefits from a cosmetic routine may diminish after discontinuation if the factors contributing to thinning or hair fall remain.
|||
Will the mask weigh down fine hair?
It is a rich conditioning treatment. Fine hair may need a smaller amount focused only on the mid-lengths and ends.

settings.title: Safety
settings.qa:
Should I patch test Prüv products?
Yes, particularly if you have sensitive skin or are using a product for the first time. Apply a small amount to a discreet area and monitor for irritation before broader use.
|||
What should I do if I experience irritation?
Stop using the product and rinse the affected area thoroughly. If symptoms are severe, persistent or worsening, seek medical advice.
|||
Can cosmetic products cause allergies?
Yes. Any cosmetic product can potentially trigger sensitivity or an allergic response in susceptible individuals. Review the ingredient list if you have known allergies.
|||
Are Prüv products suitable for sensitive scalps?
Sensitivity varies from person to person. If you have a reactive scalp, known allergies or a history of contact dermatitis, review the ingredient list carefully and patch test before full use.
|||
Can I use Prüv products during pregnancy or breastfeeding?
Individual medical circumstances vary. We recommend discussing leave-on active products, including scalp serums, with your doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
|||
Can children use Prüv products?
Prüv’s current products are formulated for adult personal care unless otherwise stated.
|||
Can teenagers use Prüv products?
Some wash-off products may be appropriate depending on the individual, but active scalp treatments should be used with parental and medical guidance where relevant.
|||
Can I use Prüv if I have dandruff, psoriasis, eczema or another scalp condition?
Prüv products are cosmetics, not treatments for diagnosed scalp disease. If you have an active or diagnosed scalp disorder, consult a dermatologist before introducing new active products.
|||
What should I do if I have sudden or severe hair loss?
Sudden, patchy, severe or unexplained hair loss should be medically evaluated. Cosmetic products should not delay diagnosis of nutritional, hormonal, autoimmune, dermatological or other underlying causes.
|||
Can I use VECTOR-5 with minoxidil or medicated scalp treatments?
Potentially, but combination routines should be discussed with a dermatologist, particularly when prescription or medicated treatments are involved.
|||
Can I use VECTOR-5 after a hair transplant?
Only after your surgeon or dermatologist confirms that the scalp has healed sufficiently and approves the use of cosmetic scalp products.
|||
Can I use Prüv after colouring, keratin, smoothing or rebonding treatments?
Often yes, but professional treatments vary significantly. Follow your salon or dermatologist’s aftercare instructions first.

settings.title: Orders & Payments
settings.qa:
How do I place an order?
Choose your products, add them to your cart and complete checkout using the payment options available on the website.
|||
Can I change my order after placing it?
Contact customer support as quickly as possible. Once an order has entered processing or has been dispatched, changes may no longer be possible.
|||
Can I cancel an order?
You can cancel your Prüv order any time before it has been dispatched by contacting our customer support team with your order details.
Once an order has been shipped, it cannot be cancelled. However, you may still be eligible for a return, replacement or refund under our Returns & Refund Policy subject to product validation.
For prepaid orders cancelled before dispatch, the full amount will be refunded to the original payment method. Please allow 5–7 business days for the refund to reflect, depending on your bank or payment provider.
|||
I entered the wrong address. What should I do?
Contact Prüv immediately with your order number and the correct details. Address changes cannot be guaranteed once a parcel has been dispatched.
|||
Can I add products to an existing order?
Once an order is confirmed, additional items may require a separate order.
|||
Is Cash on Delivery available?
No, we only accept secure online payments. To protect our customers and business from rising delivery fraud and unverified orders, we have moved to a 100% secure, prepaid-only checkout. This helps us ensure faster delivery, lower shipping costs, and guaranteed product authenticity for you.
|||
Is online payment secure?
Payments are processed through authorised payment-gateway infrastructure and are subject to the security protocols of the relevant payment provider.
|||
My payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
Failed transactions are often automatically reversed by the bank or payment provider. If the amount is not reversed within the applicable banking timeframe, contact your bank and Prüv support with the transaction reference.
|||
Will I receive an invoice?
Yes. An invoice will be provided electronically and/or with your order as applicable.
|||
Can I use more than one discount code?
No, only one discount code can be applied per order. Discount codes cannot be combined or stacked. If you have multiple codes, we recommend using the one that offers the biggest savings at checkout!
|||
Can a discount be applied after I have placed the order?
Normally, promotional codes cannot be retrospectively applied to completed orders.

settings.title: Shipping & Tracking
settings.qa:
Where does Prüv ship?
We ship to all serviceable pincodes in India.
|||
How much does shipping cost?
The shipping cost is variable based on order quantity and value. No shipping charges on orders above ₹999 .
|||
How long does delivery take?
Delivery typically takes 5 to 7 business days. All orders are processed within 24 hours before dispatch.
|||
Do you ship internationally?
We currently only ship within India. We do not offer international shipping at this time, but we hope to expand globally in the future. Follow our social media pages or subscribe to our newsletter for updates!
|||
How do I track my order?
Once your order is dispatched, tracking details will be shared through the communication channels selected by Prüv.
|||
My tracking link is not updating. What should I do?
Tracking may take 24–48 hours to update after dispatch. If there is still no movement after that period, contact customer support.
|||
My order is delayed. What should I do?
Check the tracking link first. If there has been no meaningful movement beyond the expected delivery window, contact Prüv support so the shipment can be investigated.
|||
My order says delivered, but I have not received it.
Check with household members, reception, building security or neighbor’s first. If the parcel still cannot be located, contact Prüv support promptly so the shipment can be investigated with the courier.
|||
What happens if delivery is attempted while I am unavailable?
The courier may reattempt delivery or contact you depending on the logistics provider and location.
|||
Can I change my delivery address after dispatch?
Usually not. Once the courier has received the parcel, address changes are subject to the logistics provider’s policies.
|||
What happens if my order is returned to origin?
If delivery repeatedly fails or the address is incorrect, the shipment may be returned to Prüv. Re-shipping or refund treatment will follow the published delivery and refund policy.

settings.title: Returns, Refunds & Replacements
settings.qa:
Can I return a product if I change my mind?
For hygiene and product-safety reasons, opened or used personal-care products generally cannot be returned unless defective, damaged or incorrectly supplied. See our return/refund policy for further details.
|||
Which products cannot be returned?
Except where the product is damaged, defective, incorrect or otherwise required to be accepted under applicable law, returns are not normally accepted for opened or used products, products with broken or removed seals, products damaged after delivery through misuse, improper storage or handling, products bought from unauthorised sellers, complimentary products, samples or free promotional gifts, and products where valid proof of purchase cannot be provided.
|||
Are return shipping charges refundable?
Where a claim is verified as a damaged product, defective product, incorrect product or fulfilment error attributable to Prüv, Prüv will arrange return collection or bear the reasonable cost of returning the product.
For discretionary returns accepted for reasons not attributable to Prüv, return-shipping charges may be borne by the customer or deducted from the refund. Any such charge will be communicated before the return is approved.
|||
When will I receive my refund?
Once a refund has been approved, it is initiated to the original payment method. Refunds are generally processed within 5–7 business days following approval or receipt and verification of the returned product, where applicable. The time taken to reflect in your account depends on your bank, card issuer or payment provider.
|||
How will I receive my refund?
Refunds are generally made to the original payment method unless the published policy states otherwise.
|||
My product arrived damaged. What should I do?
Contact Prüv within 7 days of delivery and provide your order number, photographs of the outer parcel, photographs or video of the damaged product, the shipping label and a description of the issue. Keep all packaging until the claim has been reviewed.
|||
I received the wrong product. What should I do?
Contact support with your order number and photographs of the products received. Once verified, Prüv will arrange the appropriate resolution.
|||
The pump or dropper is not working. What should I do?
Contact support with a short video demonstrating the issue. If the packaging is confirmed defective and the claim meets the policy requirements, a replacement may be arranged.
|||
The product leaked during shipping. What should I do?
Send clear photographs of the parcel, product, closure and leaked contents within 7 days of delivery.
|||
When am I eligible for a replacement?
Replacement may be available for products damaged in transit, materially defective, incorrectly supplied or missing from the order, subject to verification and the published policy.
|||
Do I need to return a damaged product?
Depending on the issue, Prüv may ask you to retain the product, return it, or make it available for courier pickup.
|||
What if the replacement product is out of stock?
Where an approved replacement is unavailable, Prüv may offer a refund or another appropriate resolution in accordance with the published policy.
|||
An item is missing from my order. What should I do?
Contact support promptly with your order number, photographs of everything received, the outer packaging and shipping label, and an unboxing video if available. Prüv will verify the shipment and resolve valid claims.

settings.title: Authenticity, Storage & Packaging
settings.qa:
How do I know my Prüv product is genuine?
Purchase through Prüv’s official website or authorised marketplaces and sellers. Check that the packaging, seals, batch details and statutory information are intact.
|||
Where can I buy genuine Prüv products?
The official Prüv website and authorised marketplace listings are the safest sources. Current authorised sales channels should be listed on the website.
|||
What if I bought Prüv from an unauthorised seller?
Prüv may not be able to guarantee authenticity, storage conditions or replacement eligibility for products purchased from unauthorised sellers.
|||
How should I store Prüv products?
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and excessive heat. Keep containers properly closed when not in use.
|||
Should I refrigerate VECTOR-5?
No, unless the product packaging specifically instructs you to do so.
|||
What is the shelf life of Prüv products?
Refer to the manufacturing and expiry information printed on each product.
|||
How long can I use a product after opening?
Refer to the Period After Opening symbol on the packaging where applicable.
|||
Can I use an expired product?
No.
|||
Why might colour, texture or fragrance vary slightly between batches?
Minor variation can occur with some botanical-derived ingredients. Any significant or unexpected change in colour, odour, texture or performance should be reported to customer support.
|||
Is Prüv packaging recyclable?
Recyclability depends on the packaging component and local recycling infrastructure. Separate components where possible and follow local recycling guidance.

settings.title: Customer Support
settings.qa:
How can I contact Prüv?
Email: support@getpruv.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +91-8826744421
Customer support hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
|||
What information should I provide when contacting support?
Include your full name, order number, registered email or phone number, a clear description of the issue, and photographs or video where relevant.
|||
How quickly will Prüv respond?
Our team is available Monday through Saturday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. If you reach out over the weekend or on a holiday, we will get back to you first thing on the next business day.
|||
I still have a question. What should I do?
Contact the Prüv support team using the details published on the website. We will help you identify the appropriate next step.
